name: security-browser-permissions-policy-review
intent: Delegated browser capabilities across embeds using effective Permissions Policy
artifacts: Top-level and frame response policies, iframe allow/sandbox attributes, origin chain, user grants and capability consumer.
trace: Identify the exact browser feature and how ancestor policy plus frame delegation constrains it. Separate user permission, secure-context requirements and policy denial.
experiment: In owned origins invoke only a synthetic or non-sensitive feature check with intended and untrusted embeds; record policy-denied versus user-denied outcomes.
disproof: An absent policy or permission prompt does not prove access to camera/location or any actual sensitive resource.
repair: Limit delegation to intended origins and retest allowed embedding and policy rejection without changing user grants to manufacture a result.
branch_decisions: A parent policy denying a feature cannot be broadened merely by a permissive iframe allow attribute. Record the frame origin, sandbox and user grant separately. Querying a permission status is not obtaining protected sensor data; verify the particular API operation and its policy-denied outcome.
